title: Glass Crunch Ice Bath Tanghulu
hookLine: No thermometer needed! Ice-bath method creates a thin shattering glass candy shell.

steps.title: Preheat Oven & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line your baking pan with parchment paper, leaving a slight overhang for effortless lifting. Measure out {strawberries} and {sugar_t} so everything is ready and at room temperature for a silky, lump-free batter.

steps.title: Skewer & Dry Strawberries Completely
steps.instructionTemplate: Pat {strawberries} completely dry with paper towels (any moisture prevents candy sticking) and thread onto bamboo skewers. Prepare a bowl of ice water.
steps.creatorSecret: Use room-temperature dairy and eggs for Glass Crunch Ice Bath Tanghulu, and pull it from the oven when the edges are set and a toothpick has moist crumbs—overbaking dries it out.

steps.title: Boil Syrup & Ice-Bath Dip
steps.instructionTemplate: Simmer {sugar_t} and {water_t} without stirring for 6–7 minutes until pale straw gold (hard-crack test in ice water). Spin skewers through syrup, then plunge 3 seconds into ice water for instant glass crunch!
steps.criticalTip: NEVER stir the sugar while boiling—swirl the pan gently so it stays crystal clear without crystallizing.

steps.title: Cool Completely, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer Glass Crunch Ice Bath Tanghulu to a wire cooling rack and let it cool for 15–20 minutes so the interior sets cleanly without crumbling. Lift out using the parchment overhang, garnish as desired, and slice into 4 portions.

ugcQuotes.quote: The ice bath trick worked! No burnt sugar finally 😭🙌
